mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT A.SEAT_ID as seatNumber, B.BROKER_ID as brokerId, C.ACCT_NO as acctNo, C.CCY as ccy, F.BOND_ID as shareholdersCode, F.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, F.REGIST_ORG as registOrg FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO F LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO C ON C.ACCT_NO = F.TRD_ACCT_ID AND C.CCY = F.TRD_ACCT_CCY LEFT JOIN MST_SALE_DEPARTMENT B ON B.SALE_DEPID = C.OWN_DEPT LEFT JOIN MST_SEAT A ON (A.SEAT_ID = B.SH_SEATNO OR A.SEAT_ID = B.SZ_SEATNO) WHERE (A.SEAT_ID = B.SH_SEATNO OR A.SEAT_ID = B.SZ_SEATNO) AND B.SALE_DEPID = C.OWN_DEPT

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, B.TYPE_1 as type1, B.TYPE_7 as type7, C.FACE_VALUE as faceValue FROM FIN_PRODUCT A, FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F06' AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID
SELECT A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT A, FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType}
